australian_driver_license_first_name.title: First Name
australian_driver_license_first_name.description: First name as shown on the driver's licence (e.g., 'JANE')

australian_driver_license_middle_name.title: Middle Name
australian_driver_license_middle_name.description: Middle name as shown on the driver's licence (e.g., 'LEE')

australian_driver_license_last_name.title: Last Name
australian_driver_license_last_name.description: Last name as shown on the driver's licence (e.g., 'CITIZEN')

australian_driver_license_address.title: Address
australian_driver_license_address.description: Full residential address as shown on the driver's licence

australian_driver_license_licence_number.title: Licence Number
australian_driver_license_licence_number.description: Licence number as shown on the front of the driver's licence (e.g., '987654321')

australian_driver_license_state.title: State of Issue
australian_driver_license_state.description: Australian state or territory that issued the driver's licence (e.g., 'VIC')

australian_driver_license_card_number.title: Card Number
australian_driver_license_card_number.description: Card number printed on the back of the driver's licence (e.g., 'D9999999')

australian_driver_license_class.title: Class
australian_driver_license_class.description: Licence class as shown on the driver's licence (e.g., 'CAR')

australian_driver_license_expiry_date.title: Licence Expiry
australian_driver_license_expiry_date.description: Licence expiry date as shown on the front of the driver's licence (e.g., '2019-05-20')

australian_driver_license_dob.title: Date of Birth
australian_driver_license_dob.description: Date of birth as shown on the front of the driver's licence (e.g., '1983-07-29')
